data.title: Dems seek NACC protection for exam case witnesses
data.description: <p>The Democrat Party on Monday urged the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) to protect people who were deceived or allegedly involved in a local civil service examination fraud scheme and retain them as witnesses to support its investigation.</p>

data.title: Beaten War Elephants vow fightback in Hanoi
data.description: <p>Thailand completed their final training session on Monday before flying out to Hanoi for tomorrow's decisive second leg of the Asean Hyundai Cup 2026 final against Vietnam.</p>

data.title: Thai queens cruise into last 8
data.description: <p>Defending champions Thailand claimed their second victory at the AVC Women's Volleyball Continental Championship 2026 when they defeated Indonesia 3-0 in Tianjin, China, on Monday.</p>

data.title: US proposes expanding UN Sudan arms embargo to entire country
data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - The United States proposed at the UN on Monday to expand an arms embargo on the Sudanese region of Darfur to cover all of Sudan, saying the nation's brutal conflict risks regional expansion.

data.title: Ceasefire verification mission heads to east DR Congo
data.description: KINSHASA - A mission to verify a fragile ceasefire between the Congolese army and Rwanda-backed M23 armed group was deployed Monday to the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo as the two sides traded accusations of abuse.

data.title: US removes Syria from state sponsor of terrorism list
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The United States on Monday removed Syria from its list of state sponsors of terrorism, rescinding a decades-old designation that came with severe economic restrictions and marking another step in warming ties between the countries.

data.title: Trump says to double tariffs on Canada autos as trade fight heats up
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump said Monday that he would double tariffs on Canadian vehicles beginning next year, as the neighboring countries spiral towards an escalating trade war.

data.title: North runoff spurs alarm along river
data.description: <p>The Royal Irrigation Department (RID) is closely monitoring the Chao Phraya River as runoff from the upper basin increases, with authorities preparing for higher downstream water levels.</p>

data.title: France readies high school phone ban for next month
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - The French government said Monday it would press ahead with a ban on mobile phones in high schools from next month, but trade unions warned that the measure might be hard to implement quickly.

data.title: French poll shows Le Pen's biggest challenger may be hard left's Melenchon
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - French hard-left presidential candidate Jean-Luc Melenchon may have the best chance of reaching the run-off against far-right leader Marine Le Pen in next spring's election, a new poll showed Monday, underscoring the increasingly polarised nature of the race.

data.title: Empire State Building climbers kiss outside court after viral proposal
data.description: NEW YORK - A couple who climbed to the top of the Empire State Building and got engaged appeared in a New York court Monday, before giving each other a lingering kiss in full view of the world's media.

data.title: Surasak insists on 15‑gold haul in Japan
data.description: <p>Thailand's Minister of Tourism and Sports Surasak Phancharoenworakul has set a minimum target of 15 gold medals for the national team at next month's 20th Asian Games in Nagoya, Japan.</p>

data.title: Govt 'ready' to justify PM's overseas trips
data.description: <p>The government is prepared to defend Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul's foreign policy and overseas trips with concrete results when parliament holds a no-confidence debate, government spokeswoman Rachada Dhnadirek said on Monday.</p>

data.title: Remote surgery 'successful'
data.description: <p>Thailand has performed its first remote robotic surgery for prostate cancer, with a surgical team in Bangkok operating on a patient about 250 kilometres away in Nakhon Ratchasima.</p>

data.title: Committee to review cases for amnesty
data.description: <p>A special committee will review all political cases from 2005&ndash;2025 under the newly enacted Peaceful Society Promotion Act, Prime Minister's Office Minister Paradorn Prissananantakul said.</p>

data.title: KPI chief faces probe over alleged admissions scam
data.description: <p>House Speaker Sophon Zarum has ordered a fact-finding investigation into allegations that King Prajadhipok's Institute (KPI) secretary-general Issara Sereewatthanawut solicited benefits in exchange for admission to an executive programme.</p>

data.title: Business nominee crackdown widens
data.description: <p>Authorities are widening their crackdown on foreign nominee businesses and "grey capital", going beyond raids and asset seizures to trace ownership structures, financial flows and Thai shareholders.</p>

data.title: FM Sihasak kicks off Africa trip
data.description: <p>Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow begins his first official visit to Africa on Tuesday as Thailand seeks to deepen its ties with Nigeria, Ethiopia and the wider continent.</p>

data.title: Navy to extend border fence
data.description: <p>The Royal Thai Navy (RTN) will extend a border fence along the Thai-Cambodian frontier in Chanthaburi by more than 8km as authorities step up security measures along the disputed border.</p>

data.title: NIA cites 3 factors for attacks
data.description: <p>The National Intelligence Agency (NIA) has identified three possible factors behind a series of attacks at more than 50 locations in the deep South late last week, saying they could be linked to preparations for renewed peace talks and an upcoming military rotation.</p>
